verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS compliance platform, so asking whether users can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The docs cover only the API's authentication, rate limits and idempotency, plus product features and pricing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
